interpretation: The 110 shared forms are all reference-known, and the preserved reference transcript identifiers are also equal in all 110 pairs. Native original-ID matching is therefore a descriptive naming baseline, not evidence of an advantage over shared reference aliases. The 16 IsoQuant-only and 75 StringTie-only forms have unequal coordinates relative to every form in the other output; they are not TxID false splits. This case does not validate shared novel exact forms, transcript-discovery accuracy or biological truth.
method: Classifications are taken from each caller first-import mapping in its separately initialized registry, relative to the shared GENCODE v29 chr22 identity-view annotation. They are TxID annotation classifications, not independently validated biological novelty. Exact-form intersection is calculated by txid_form. Direct contig/strand/exon-coordinate tuple comparisons in the retained independent-reader evidence verify the unmatched forms have no exact coordinate counterpart in the other output.
